root_cause: Interface FastEthernet0/4 on SW1 is incorrectly configured in VLAN 20 instead of VLAN 10, preventing Layer 2 communication between PC1 and PC2.
evidence: show vlan brief displays FastEthernet0/4 under VLAN 20 (IT) rather than VLAN 10 | show interfaces Fa0/4 switchport confirms Access Mode VLAN: 20 (IT)
fix_steps: Enter configuration mode on SW1 and select interface FastEthernet0/4 | Run switchport access vlan 10 to assign the port to VLAN 10 | Verify the port assignment using show vlan brief or show interfaces Fa0/4 switchport | Have the human reviewer re-test ping connectivity between PC1 and PC2
